extraction_metadata.extraction_notes: Single SoA table (ISA Section 1.3) printed over document pages 11-14 under a header reprinted on every page; the intro text on p.11 is table-wide note g1; footnote a below the table (p.14) is bound to the eight rows whose Notes cell reads 'See footnote a.'. Text-layer PDF, not glyph-spread. Marks verified by pdftotext -bbox column binning (no disagreement with the visual read). Cell boundaries from raster rule lines (§1d); where a redaction bar hides a rule (p.13, Urine drug screen / HbA1c) rows were taken from the text lines. Notes column cells captured with synthesised markers n1-n18. Abbreviation list dropped (it carries one CCI box).

table_metadata.table_purpose: ISA BP05 (LY3857210, chronic low back pain) schedule: visits and procedures unique to the ISA, on top of the master CPMP and CLBP DSA CPMP(2) SoAs; prints the screening visits V1-V2 and V3-V7, ED of the master and adds follow-up visit V801
table_metadata.notes: One label column (L=1); data columns at positions 2-10 (V1 -> 2, V2 -> 3, V3 -> 4, V4 -> 5, V5 -> 6, V6 -> 7, V7 -> 8, ED -> 9, V801 -> 10); the right-hand Notes column is not a schedule column. Typed main_soa: every participant in this ISA passes through it in sequence. It is a delta schedule: the intro text says it shows only what is unique to the ISA; footnote a ('Collect in addition to schedule described in the Master Protocol CPMP.') marks eight rows as additions to the master schedule. Section bands 'Scales, Questionnaires, and Outcome Measures' and 'Clinical Laboratory Tests and Sample Collection' group the rows below them. Four redaction bars hide rows; their row positions (19, 34, 37, 38) are unassigned and may each stand for more than one row. p.14 shows only the header and one bar.

schedule_properties.property_comment: Top header band: 'Screening' spanning V1-V2, 'Randomization to ISA' (V3; printed 'Randomizati / on to ISA', a word broken by the narrow column), 'Double-Blind Treatment' spanning V4-V7, blank over ED, 'F/U' (V801). Typed by the values that span several columns (study phases) -> epoch. The label cell is blank, so the name is synthesised.
Visit identifiers V1-V7, ED, V801 -> visit. The label cell is blank, so the name is synthesised.

Study week per visit: 'Up to -6 month' (V1), '-10 to -7 days for most participants' (V2), 0, 2, 4, 6, 8 (V3-V7), blank for ED, '+2' (V801) -> week; the two screening values are relative times printed in this row.
Allowed deviation in days: blank for V1-V3, one '±3' cell merged across V4-V7, blank for ED, '±3' for V801 -> window; a qualifier of the columns, so hierarchical_level null.

annotations.annotation_text: This SoA shows visits and procedures unique to the intervention-specific appendix (ISA) H0P-MC-BP05 for LY3857210. Please refer to the Master Protocol CPMP and the CLBP DSA CPMP(2) SoAs for additional information.
Collect in addition to schedule described in the Master Protocol CPMP.
See Section 8.2.1.
Complete physical examination, including targeted examination specified below, should be performed at V3 and V801 or ED.
Targeted physical examination for skin, gastrointestinal tract, mammary gland in males, and lymph nodes should also be performed at V5 and V7.
See Section 8.2.1
Includes diagnosis and symptom onset date.
At V3, take vitals before dosing.
Vitals include pulse rate, respiratory rate, blood pressure, and temperature, taken with participant in a sitting position.
Should view at the beginning of V2.
See Section 6.1. Instruct participant to NOT take study intervention on the day of V7.
Participant to bring study intervention to every visit.
Complete 1 form for each event identified on the Self-Harm Supplement form.
Review eDiary compliance.
Review assessment of pain. See MoO for additional details.
For all WOCBP at V3, collect sample within 24 hours prior to dosing.
See Section 5.3.1.
At V3, a PK sample should be taken any time after 1 hour post dose and prior to leaving the site.
At V4, V5, V6, V7 and ED, a PK sample can be taken at any time during the site visit.
The date and time of each PK sample collected will be recorded. The date and time of LY3857210 administration prior to the PK sample collection will be recorded.

review_items.call_made: Footnote a, printed below the table on p.14 ('Collect in addition to schedule described in the Master Protocol CPMP.'), is bound to the eight rows whose Notes cell reads 'See footnote a.' Each of these rows has its only mark at V801.
